finalists.label: Anti-NMDAR Encephalitis
finalists.why: This candidate has strong specific evidence including positive anti-NMDAR antibodies and symptoms like hallucinations and nonsensical speech.

finalists.label: Encephalitis
finalists.why: This candidate is supported by a broad range of symptoms including left-sided weakness, hallucinations, and positive anti-NMDAR antibodies, though it's less specific than Anti-NMDAR Encephalitis.

finalists.label: Candidiasis
finalists.why: Although it has specific evidence from CSF next-generation sequencing, its connection to the patient's overall clinical presentation is less clear compared to encephalitis-related candidates.

frontier_selector.why: The presence of anti-NMDAR antibodies and specific symptoms like intermittent hallucinations and nonsensical speech decided the final comparison in favor of Anti-NMDAR Encephalitis.
